title: Condor Rising
style: .trans anthem with reggaeton accents in the bridges; rising synth layers, hard kicks, dubstep subbass; sidechain-pumped synths and roomy, unprocessed vocals; baritone male rap against crooning legato soprano melodies, soaring repetitive hooks; fast, rave-driven builds into euphoric drops
lyrics:
[Build – male rap – rising synths, hard kicks]
Yo, from the Andes peaks where the mountains scrape the sky
Condor’s the name, national bird, watch it fly
Colombia, Ecuador, Bolivia, Perú
Highest level of the rails, that’s the Condor crew

I started in Colombia, proximity right
Bid to Venezuela in the political night
Peru and Bolivia still keep the tracks alive
High-speed passenger service, Condor brand survive

[Drop – female melodic – soaring, euphoric]
Condor! Condor! Rising high!
Condor! Condor! Touch the sky!
Name the people know, name that makes us fly
Condor! Condor! Condor!

[Build – male rap]
Behind the Condor shine the real heavy tracks
Cargo rolling up and down the mountain backs
Ports to the peaks, peaks to the sea
Moving the load, that’s the working horse free

Passengers get tiers, two more to the sky
Intercity Toucans taking Colombia high
Regional services, operators choose the name
But the Condor flies the fastest of the game

[Drop – female melodic]
Condors, Toucans, Macaws!
Significant birds, significant brands!
High-speed railways, intercity, aviation
Behind it all the cargo trains keep rolling on!

Condor! Condor! Rising high!
Condor! Condor! Touch the sky!
Name the people know, name that makes us fly
Condor! Condor! Condor!

[Build – male rap – final build, bigger energy]
Condors for the speed, Toucans for the ride
Macaws in the regions, cargo never dies
Andean integrated railway, mountains in our veins
One brand above them all — Condor reigns!

[Drop – female melodic – max anthem, repetitive hooks]
Condor! Condor! Rising high!
Condor! Condor! Touch the sky!
Condors, Toucans, Macaws fly!
Condor! Condor! Condor!

Condor! Condor! Rising high!
Condor! Condor! Touch the sky!
Name the people know, name that makes us fly
Condor! Condor! Condor!

[Outro – fading female echo over trance breakdown]
Condor… Condor… rising… high…
